mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within two months signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) by more than 5% over three months signals a strong demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over two months signals increased economic activity and supply, which is a positive indicator for corporate earnings and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL below 2% annualized) signals a stable monetary policy, which reduces uncertainty and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL is below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3% within a month, it signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% annually and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) remains below 3% annualized, it signals strong economic growth without significant inflation, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 grows > 2% annually and CPIAUCSL < 3% annually
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% within a quarter, coupled with an increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the same period, signals a supportive monetary policy and increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.5% and INDPRO increases > 1% in 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.
